exposure: vaginal insertion of Post-Partum Intrauterine Contraceptive device (PPIUCD)
intra-cesarean insertion of Post-Partum Intrauterine Contraceptive device (PPIUCD)
finding: Both vaginal and intra-cesarean insertion of PPIUCD were found to have low rates of complications and high contraceptive efficacy.
mod_finding: PPIUCD insertion, whether performed vaginally or during cesarean, is a safe and effective method of postpartum contraception.
